answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in horizon, expire in ferrous, and tide lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 111 aliases as a result needs 114 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 173 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
